card.name: Punctuation inside hypersensitivity warnings
card.fires_on: A comma or the word "or" right after a short term in allergy and hypersensitivity warnings, such as after "Severe" or after "fever". It comes just before the next item in a list of reaction terms.

modes.label: Comma after Severe
modes.description: The comma after "Severe" in the NSAID contraindication about aspirin-type allergic reactions.
modes.example: History of asthma, urticaria, or other allergic-type reactions after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs. Severe<<,>> sometimes fatal, anaphylactic reactions

modes.label: "or" after fever
modes.description: The word "or" after "fever" in a list of early hypersensitivity signs.
modes.example: early manifestations of hypersensitivity, such as fever<< or>> lymphadenopathy, may be present even

card.plain: It fires on the small joining comma or "or" inside allergy warning lists, just before the next reaction term.
